reason: the design fails 1 of its checks

findings.text: DSFSTG-4 is marked [done], and its evidence core/pipeline/runner.sh:"--from-stage is in the code from before this change, but this branch has since moved or changed every line that holds it. What runs now is this branch's code, not the old one, so it is not done: tag DSFSTG-4 [code] and give it a test

answers: design finding 1: wrong — The design checker says the [done] evidence is tainted because "this branch has since moved or changed every line that holds it." But the [done] semantics require the evidence text to be in the base commit, and it is: `error "--from-stage is only valid with --resume"` is at line 1738 of the base code, in the guard block that precedes the auto-resume elif. The acceptance-gate confirmed independently that a test for DSFSTG-4's behavior already passes on the base code — which is definitive proof that [code] is impossible (a [code] test must FAIL on base code). Reclassifying to [code] would cause the acceptance gate to fail again for the same reason. The Gap 12 step (restoring the guard's position before the auto-resume elif) is the right vehicle for the branch regression fix; it does not require a new SPEC test because the base code already satisfies the behavior. DSFSTG-4[done] is the only valid classification and the design stays as written.

acceptance-gate finding 1: wrong — This finding says DSFSTG-4's test passes on base code, so it cannot be [code]. The design already has DSFSTG-4[done] — the classification is consistent with the finding. No change needed.

lens-correctness-design finding 1: wrong — The design already addresses the exact scenario the lens describes. Gap 11 documents it: after the target unit is found and `skip_until_stage` is cleared in either dispatch-unit arm, `resume_mode` is set to `false` immediately (`[[ -n "$skip_until_stage" ]] && { skip_until_stage=""; resume_mode=false; }`), which prevents the resume skip guard from activating for stages after `<s>` in combined `--resume --from-stage <s>` mode. DSFSTG-3[code] pins the observable behavior (stages after `<s>` that are marked complete are still dispatched, no stage.skip emitted), and Finding 31 in the design document explicitly records that this lens finding is addressed by Gap 11 and DSFSTG-3. The Decision paragraph and the from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh step both specify the fix and the test.
